children.text: pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ vastū pudgalānāṃ tathaiva ca Ś

children.translated_text: The section on the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> monks, and likewise on individuals,
then on those undergoing probation (<s>pārivāsika</s>), and with the suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>,
lodgings (<s>śayanāsana</s>), disputes (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>), and the schism of the <s>Saṃgha</s> as the last.
The act of censure (<s>tarjanīya</s>) for the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> monks and the act of reproof (<s>nigarhaṇīya</s>) for <s>Śreyaka</s>,
and likewise for not making amends (<s>apratikaraṇā</s>); <s>Ariṣṭa</s>'s wrong views (<s>pāpīkā dṛṣṭi</s>)

body.translated_text: the banishment (<s>pravāsa</s>) for <s>Aśvaka</s> and <s>Punarvasu</s>, and <s>Uttara</s> and the reconciliation (<s>pratisaṃhāra</s>,

children.text: buddho bhagavāṃ śrāvastyāṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme

children.translated_text: The <s>Buddha</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, was dwelling in <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, in the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

children.text: tena khalu samayena śrāvastyāṃ pāṇḍulohitakā bhikṣavaḥ prativasanti kalahakārakā bhaṇḍanakārakā vigrahakārakā vivādakārakā ādhikaraṇikā

children.translated_text: At that time, in <s>Śrāvastī</s>, the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> were residing — makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, litigious

children.text: te saṃghe 'bhīkṣṇam adhikaraṇāny utpādayanti yena saṃghaḥ kalahajāto viharati bhaṇḍanajāto vigṛhīto vivādam āpannaḥ

children.translated_text: They constantly stirred up legal cases (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>) in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so that the <s>Saṃgha</s> dwelt in quarrel, dwelt in dispute, was in conflict, had fallen into arguments.

children.text: etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti / bhagavān āha / kuruta yūyaṃ bhikṣavaḥ pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahakārakāṇāṃ bhaṇḍanakārakāṇāṃ vigṛhītānāṃ vivādam āpannānām ādhikaraṇikānāṃ tarjanīyaṃ karma iti / yo vā punar anyo 'py evaṃjātīyaḥ /

children.translated_text: The <s>bhikṣus</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: "You <s>bhikṣus</s> should perform the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> who are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, who are in conflict, who have fallen into arguments, who are litigious." And likewise for anyone else of such a kind.

children.text: paṃcabhiḥ kāraṇāis tarjanīyaṃ karma kṛtam adharmakarma ca tad avinayakarma ca saṃghaś ca tena sātisāraḥ / katamaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ

children.translated_text: When the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) has been performed on five grounds, it is an unlawful act (<s>adharmakarma</s>) and an act contrary to the discipline (<s>avinayakarma</s>), and the <s>Saṃgha</s> incurs an offense (<s>sātisāra</s>) thereby. What are the five?

children.text: acodayitvā kurvanty asmārayitvā avastukam apratijñayā asaṃmukhībhūtasya kurvanti /

children.translated_text: They perform it without having charged [the accused], without having reminded [him], without a factual basis, without a confession, and against one not present.

children.text: paṃcabhis tu kāraṇais tarjanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ dharmakarma ca tad vinayakarma ca saṃghaś ca tena na sātisāraḥ

children.translated_text: But when the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) has been performed on five grounds, it is a lawful act (<s>dharmakarma</s>) and an act in accordance with the discipline (<s>vinayakarma</s>), and the <s>Saṃgha</s> does not incur an offense thereby.

children.text: codayitvā kurvanti smārayitvā savastukaṃ pratijñayā saṃmukhī

children.translated_text: They perform it after having charged [him], after having reminded [him], with a factual basis, with a confession, and in the presence of
And it should be done as follows:

children.text: śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍīm ākoṭya pṛṣṭavācikayā bhikṣūn samanuyujya sarvasaṃghe saṃniṣaṇṇe saṃnipatite ekena bhikṣuṇā jñaptiṃ kṛtvā karma kartavyam*

children.translated_text: Having arranged the lodgings, having struck the <s>gaṇḍī</s> (gong), having summoned the <s>bhikṣus</s> by proxy, when the entire <s>Saṃgha</s> is seated and assembled, one <s>bhikṣu</s> should make the motion (<s>jñapti</s>) and then the formal act (<s>karma</s>) should be performed.

children.text: ime pāṇḍulohitakā bhikṣavaḥ kalahakārakā bhaṇḍanakārakā vigrahakārakā vivādakārakā ādhikaraṇikāḥ

children.translated_text: These <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, litigious.

children.text: ta ete abhīkṣṇaṃ saṃghe adhikaraṇāny utpādayanti yena saṃghaḥ kalahajāto viharati bhaṇḍanajāto vigṛhīto vivādam āpannaḥ

children.translated_text: They constantly stir up legal cases in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so that the <s>Saṃgha</s> dwells in quarrel, dwells in dispute, is in conflict, has fallen into arguments.

children.text: sacet saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ kṣametānujānīyāt saṃgho yat saṃghaḥ pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahakārakāṇāṃ bhaṇḍanakārakāṇāṃ vigrahakārakāṇāṃ vivādakārakāṇām ādhikaraṇikānāṃ tarjanīyaṃ karma kuryād ity eṣā jñaptiḥ //

children.translated_text: If the time is right for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, may the <s>Saṃgha</s> approve and authorize that the <s>Saṃgha</s> should perform the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> who are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, who are litigious. This is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).
Then the formal act (<s>karma</s>) should be performed:

children.text: ime pāṇḍulohitakā bhikṣavaḥ kalahakārakā bhaṇḍanakārakā vigrahakārakā vivādakārakā ādhikaraṇikāḥ

children.translated_text: These <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, litigious.

children.text: ta ete abhīkṣṇaṃ saṃghe adhikaraṇāny utpādayanti yena saṃghaḥ kalahajāto viharati bhaṇḍanajāto viharati vigṛhīto vivādam āpannaḥ

children.translated_text: They constantly stir up legal cases in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so that the <s>Saṃgha</s> dwells in quarrel, dwells in dispute, is in conflict, has fallen into arguments.

children.text: pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahakārakāṇāṃ bhaṇḍanakārakāṇāṃ vigrahakārakāṇāṃ vivādakārakāṇām ādhikaraṇikānāṃ tarjanīyakarma karoti

children.translated_text: performs the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> who are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, who are litigious.

children.text: ) āyuṣmatāṃ kṣamate pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ pūrvavad yāvat tarjanīyaṃ karma kartuṃ te tūṣṇīṃ na kṣamate bhāṣantām

children.translated_text: ) the venerable ones who approve of performing the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> as stated before, should remain silent; those who do not approve should speak.
This is the first proclamation of the formal act (<s>karmavācanā</s>).

children.text: evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācanā kartavyā // kṛtaṃ saṃghena pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ pūrvavad yāvat tarjanīyaṃ karma

children.translated_text: Likewise the second and third proclamation of the formal act should be performed. The <s>Saṃgha</s> has performed the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> as stated before.

children.text: kṣāntam anujñātaṃ saṃghena yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi /

children.translated_text: It has been approved and authorized by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, since [they] remained silent; thus I hold it.

children.text: tarjanīyakarmakṛtasyāhaṃ bhikṣor āsamudācārikān dharmān prajñapayāmi Ś tarjanīyakarmakṛtena bhikṣuṇā na pravrājayitavyaṃ

children.translated_text: I prescribe the rules of proper conduct (<s>āsamudācārika dharma</s>) for a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has received the act of censure (<s>tarjanīyakarmakṛta</s>): a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has received the act of censure should not give ordination (<s>pravrajyā</s>),
should not grant full ordination (<s>upasaṃpadā</s>), should not give guidance (<s>niśraya</s>),
should not be appointed as an instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>,
nor even if previously appointed should he instruct the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (<s>avavād</s>-

children.text: na bhikṣuś codayitavyaḥ smārayitavyaḥ śīlavipattyā dṛṣṭivipattyā ācāravipattyā ājīvavipattyā sthāpayitavyo

children.translated_text: should not charge a <s>bhikṣu</s>, should not remind [him]; should not be suspended for failure in morality (<s>śīlavipatti</s>), failure in views (<s>dṛṣṭivipatti</s>), failure in conduct (<s>ācāravipatti</s>), or failure in livelihood (<s>ājīvavipatti</s>),

children.text: na poṣadho na pravāraṇā na jñaptikarma na jñapticaturthaṃ karma

children.translated_text: should not perform <s>Poṣadha</s>, nor <s>Pravāraṇā</s>, nor an act requiring a motion (<s>jñaptikarma</s>), nor a formal act with the fourth motion (<s>jñapticaturthaṃ karma</s>).
[A bhikṣu who has received] the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya</s>)

children.text: kṛto bhikṣur yathā prajñaptān āsamudācārikān dharmān na samādāya vartate sātisāro bhavati /

children.translated_text: — a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has received [it] and does not observe the prescribed rules of proper conduct (<s>āsamudācārika dharma</s>) incurs an offense (<s>sātisāra</s>).

children.text: evaṃ tarjanīyakarmakṛtā utkacaprakacāḥ saṃghe roma pātayanti niḥsaraṇaṃ pravartayanti sāmīcīm upadarśayanty antaḥsīmāyāṃ sthitvā osāraṇāṃ yācante kalahakārakatvāc ca prativiramāma iti kathayanti

children.translated_text: Thus, those who have received the act of censure (<s>tarjanīyakarmakṛta</s>), with shaven heads (<s>utkacaprakaca</s>), humble themselves before the <s>Saṃgha</s> (<s>roma pātayanti</s>), undertake departure (<s>niḥsaraṇa</s>), show proper conduct (<s>sāmīcī</s>), and standing within the boundary (<s>antaḥsīmā</s>), request reinstatement (<s>osāraṇā</s>), and declare: "We desist from being makers of quarrels."

children.text: etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti Ś bhagavān āha / osārayata yūyaṃ bhikṣavaḥ pāṇḍulohitakān bhikṣūn kalahakārakāṃs tarjanīyakarmakṛtān iti Ś yo vā punar anyo 'py evaṃjātīyaḥ

children.translated_text: The <s>bhikṣus</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: "You <s>bhikṣus</s> should reinstate (<s>osārayata</s>) the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s> who are makers of quarrels and who have received the act of censure." And likewise for anyone else of such a kind.
One who has received the act of censure (<s>tarjanīyakarmakṛta</s>) and possesses five qualities should not be reinstated (<s>nosārayitavya</s>).
He does not have a shaven head (<s>notkacaprakaca</s>)

children.text: saṃghe roma pātayati Ś na niḥsaraṇaṃ pravartayati na sāmīcīm upadarśayati nāntaḥsīmāyāṃ sthitvā osāraṇāṃ yācate Ś tasmāc ca kalahakārakatvāc ca na prativiramā

children.translated_text: he does not humble himself before the <s>Saṃgha</s>, he does not undertake departure (<s>niḥsaraṇa</s>), he does not show proper conduct (<s>sāmīcī</s>), he does not stand within the boundary and request reinstatement (<s>osāraṇā</s>), and he does not desist from being a maker of quarrels (<s>kalahakārakatva</s>), he does not say 'I desist'
Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛto nosārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should not be reinstated.

children.text: rājakulapratisaraṇo bhavati yuktakulapratisaraṇas tīrthikapratisaraṇaḥ pudgalapratisaraṇo na saṃghapratisaraṇaḥ

children.translated_text: He takes refuge in the royal court, takes refuge in powerful families, takes refuge in non-Buddhist ascetics (<s>tīrthika</s>), takes refuge in individuals, and does not take refuge in the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛto nosārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should not be reinstated.
He bears the banner of a householder (<s>āgārikadhvaja</s>), bears the banner of a non-Buddhist ascetic (<s>tīrthikadhvaja</s>), associates with non-Buddhists (<s>tīrthya</s>)
attends upon [them], engages in improper conduct (<s>anadhyācāra</s>), does not train in the training of <s>bhikṣus</s>
Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛto nosārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should not be reinstated.

children.text: bhikṣūn ākrośati roṣayati paribhāṣate Ś saṃghasya ca alābhāya avasādāya cetayati

children.translated_text: He abuses <s>bhikṣus</s>, angers them, reviles them, and he acts for the loss and decline of the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: paṃcabhis tu dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛta osārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: But one who has received the act of censure and possesses five qualities should be reinstated (<s>osārayitavya</s>).

children.text: utkacaprakacaḥ saṃghe roma pātayati niḥsaraṇaṃ pravartayati sāmīcīm upadarśayaty antaḥsīmāyā

children.translated_text: He has a shaven head (<s>utkacaprakaca</s>), he humbles himself before the <s>Saṃgha</s>, he undertakes departure (<s>niḥsaraṇa</s>), he shows proper conduct (<s>sāmīcī</s>), standing within the boundary (<s>antaḥsīmā</s>)

children.text: yācate / kalahakārakatvāc ca prativiramāmīti Ś vadati Ś ebhiḥ paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas (

children.translated_text: He says: "I desist from being a maker of quarrels." Possessing these five qualities, (
) one who has received the act of censure should be reinstated.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛta osārayitavyaḥ /

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should be reinstated.

children.text: na rājakulapratisaraṇo bhavati na yuktakulapratisaraṇo na tīrthikapratisaraṇaḥ saṃghapratisaraṇo na pudgalapratisaraṇaḥ

children.translated_text: He does not take refuge in the royal court, does not take refuge in powerful families, does not take refuge in non-Buddhist ascetics; he takes refuge in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, not in individuals.
Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛta osārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should be reinstated.

children.text: nāgārikadhvajaṃ dhārayati na tīrthikadhvajaṃ dhārayati na tīrthyāṃ sevate na bhajate na paryupāste adhyācāram ācarati bhikṣuśikṣāyāṃ śikṣate Ś ebhiḥ paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ pūrvavat*

children.translated_text: He does not bear the banner of a householder, does not bear the banner of a non-Buddhist ascetic, does not associate with non-Buddhists, does not frequent them, does not attend upon them, engages in proper conduct (<s>adhyācāra</s>), trains in the training of <s>bhikṣus</s>. Possessing these five qualities, as stated before.

children.text: aparair api paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgatas tarjanīyakarmakṛta osārayitavyaḥ

children.translated_text: Furthermore, one who has received the act of censure and possesses another five qualities should be reinstated.

children.text: na bhikṣūn ākrośati na roṣayati na paribhāṣate saṃghasya lābhāya

children.translated_text: He does not abuse <s>bhikṣus</s>, does not anger them, does not revile them, he acts for the gain of the <s>Saṃgha</s>,
And he should be reinstated as follows:

children.text: śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍīm ākoṭya pṛṣṭavācikayā bhikṣūn samanuyujya sarvasaṃghe saṃniṣaṇṇe saṃnipatite pāṇḍulohitakair bhikṣubhir yathāvṛddhikayā sāmīcīṃ kṛtvā vṛddhānte utkuṭukena sthitvā añjaliṃ pragṛhya idaṃ syād vacanīyaṃ

children.translated_text: Having arranged the lodgings, having struck the <s>gaṇḍī</s> (gong), having summoned the <s>bhikṣus</s> by proxy, when the entire <s>Saṃgha</s> is seated and assembled, the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s>, having shown respect (<s>sāmīcī</s>) in order of seniority, standing at the end in a crouching position (<s>utkuṭuka</s>), with palms joined, should say the following:

children.text: vayaṃ pāṇḍulohitakā bhikṣavaḥ kalahakārakā bhaṇḍanakārakā vigrahakārakā vivādakārakā ādhikaraṇikāḥ

children.translated_text: We, the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s>, are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, litigious.

children.text: te vayam abhīkṣṇaṃ saṃghe adhikaraṇāny utpādayāmo yena saṃghaḥ kalahajāto viharati bhaṇḍanajāto vigṛhīto vivādam āpannaḥ

children.translated_text: We constantly stir up legal cases in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so that the <s>Saṃgha</s> dwells in quarrel, dwells in dispute, is in conflict, has fallen into arguments.

children.text: teṣām asmākaṃ pāṇḍulohitakānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahakārakāṇāṃ bhaṇḍanakārakāṇāṃ vigrahakārakāṇāṃ vivādakārakāṇām ādhikaraṇikānāṃ saṃghena tarjanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ

children.translated_text: The <s>Saṃgha</s> has performed the act of censure (<s>tarjanīya karma</s>) against us, the <s>Pāṇḍulohitaka</s> <s>bhikṣus</s>, who are makers of quarrels, makers of disputes, makers of conflicts, makers of arguments, who are litigious.
We, having received the act of censure, with shaven heads (<s>utkacaprakaca</s>)

children.text: saṃghe roma pātayāmo niḥsaraṇaṃ pravartayāmaḥ sāmīcīm upadarśayāmaḥ antaḥsīmāyā

children.translated_text: humble ourselves before the <s>Saṃgha</s>, undertake departure (<s>niḥsaraṇa</s>), show proper conduct (<s>sāmīcī</s>), standing within the boundary (<s>antaḥsīmā</s>)

children.text: sthitvā osāraṇāṃ yācāmahe Ś kalahakārakatvāc ca prativiramāmaḥ osārayatv asmākaṃ bhadantāḥ saṃgha

children.translated_text: and request reinstatement (<s>osāraṇā</s>). We desist from being makers of quarrels. May the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> reinstate

children.text: pāṇḍulohitakān bhikṣūn kalahakārakān vivādakārakān ādhikaraṇikāṃs tarjanīyakarmakṛtān anukaṃpa

they strung garlands and had them strung;

children.text: vādāpayataḥ / sunṛtyeṣu sugīteṣu suvāditeṣu lālāṭikām anuprayacchata
children.translated_text: and made others play music; at beautiful dances, beautiful songs, and beautiful instrumental performances, they gave applause;
gathering up their robes, they ran, dashed, and sprinted;

children.text: ūruparivartam api kurutaḥ bāhuparivartam api / rohitāvartam api
children.translated_text: they also performed the thigh-turn and the arm-turn; and the fish-swirl;
they also shot water from slings;
they also played the water-wheel and the water-drum;

children.text: hastikrauñcam api krūñcataḥ aśvaheṣitam api heṣata
children.translated_text: they also trumpeted like elephants and neighed like horses;
they also imitated the cry of peacocks;
they also imitated the song of cuckoos;

children.text: aśvayuddham ṛṣabhayuddhaṃ mahiṣayuddham ajayuddhaṃ piṇḍakayuddhaṃ strīyuddhaṃ puruṣayuddhaṃ kumārakayuddhaṃ kumārikāyuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vartakayuddhaṃ lāvakayuddhaṃ kurutaḥ kārayata
children.translated_text: horse-fights, bull-fights, buffalo-fights, goat-fights, fist-fights, women's fights, men's fights, boys' fights, girls' fights, cock-fights, quail-fights, and partridge-fights — they staged and caused [others] to stage them;
these and other non-<s>śramaṇa</s> acts they performed

children.text: tayos tayā īryayā caryayā pratipattyā kiṭāgirim anāgatāś ca bhikṣavo nāgaccganty
children.translated_text: Because of their conduct and behavior and practice, <s>bhikṣus</s> who had not come to <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> would not come,

children.text: āgatāś ca nābhiramante tyajanti kiṭāgirau vāsaṃ
children.translated_text: Those who come [to Kiṭāgiri] are not pleased, and they abandon their residence at <s>Kiṭāgiri</s>,
and the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders dwelling at <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> are displeased and dissatisfied.

children.text: naivāsikānām api cirānugatānāṃ kṛcchreṇa piṇḍakaṃ dātavyaṃ kartavyaṃ many
children.translated_text: They think that alms-food must be given with difficulty even to permanent residents who have long attended them —
how much more so for newcomers?

children.text: yāvad apareṇa samayenāyuṣmān ānandaḥ kāśīṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ caraṃ kiṭāgirim anuprāptaḥ
children.translated_text: Then, on another occasion, the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, wandering on a tour through the <s>Kāśī</s> districts, arrived at <s>Kiṭāgiri</s>.

children.text: athāyuṣmān ānandaḥ pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaram ādāya kiṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya praviṣṭa
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, having dressed in the morning and taken his bowl and robe, entered <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> for alms.

children.text: Ś sa yathā dhautena pātreṇa kiṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya praviṣṭas tathā dhautenaiva pātreṇa pratiniṣkrānto 'labdhvā dānam alabdh
children.translated_text: Just as he entered <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> for alms with a clean bowl, so he came out with a clean bowl, having received neither a gift nor
a refusal — not even a single morsel of food.
Then this thought occurred to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>:

children.text: sphītaś ca kṣemaś ca subhikṣaś cākīrṇabahujanamanuṣyaś ca sulabhaś cārupiṇḍako yācanakena
children.translated_text: and flourishing, secure, well-provisioned, crowded with many people, and alms-food was easily obtained by begging.

children.text: etarhy apy ayaṃ kiṭāgiri ṛddhaś ca sphītaś ca kṣema
children.translated_text: Even now this <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> is prosperous and flourishing, secure,
well-provisioned, and crowded with many people.

children.text: yathā dhautenaiva pātreṇa praviṣṭas tathā dhautena pātreṇa pratiniṣkrānto 'labdhvā dānam alabdhvā pratyākhyānaṃ antata ekabhikṣām api
children.translated_text: have come out with a clean bowl just as I entered, having received neither a gift nor a refusal — not even a single morsel of food.

children.text: mā haivātra kenacid bhagavataḥ śrāvakena mūḍhenāvyaktenākuśalena kleśavaśāt kulastrī vā kulakumārī vā ābhāṣitā vā bhaviṣyaty āmṛṣṭā vā paribhāṣitā
children.translated_text: Could it be that some foolish, undeveloped, unskilled disciple of the Blessed One, overcome by defilements, has accosted, touched, or insulted a family-woman or a family-maiden here?'

children.text: tena khalu samayena kiṭāgirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnāṃ saṃsthāgāre paṃcamātrāṇi brāhmaṇagṛhapatiśatāni saṃniṣaṇṇāni saṃnipatitāni kenacid eva karaṇīyena
children.translated_text: Now at that time, five hundred <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders of <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> had assembled and gathered at the assembly hall for some business.

children.text: athāyuṣmān ānando yena kiṭāgirīyakānāṃ brāhmaṇagṛhapatīnāṃ saṃsthāgāras tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> approached the assembly hall of the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders of <s>Kiṭāgiri</s>.
Having approached, he addressed the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders of <s>Kiṭāgiri</s>
[was prosperous]... as before, up to: not even a single morsel of food.'

children.text: evam uktāḥ kiṭāgirīyakā brāhmaṇagṛhapataya indriyāṇy utkṣipyāvasthitā
children.translated_text: When thus addressed, the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders of <s>Kiṭāgiri</s> stood with their senses averted.

children.text: tena khalu samayenodakaplotika upāsakas tasyām eva pariṣadi saṃniṣaṇṇo 'bhūt saṃnipatitaḥ
children.translated_text: Now at that time, the lay follower <s>Udakaplotika</s> was seated in that very assembly, having gathered there.
Then the lay follower <s>Udakaplotika</s>, taking the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>

children.text: bāhuṃ gṛhītvā ekānte prakramyāyuṣmantam ānandam idam avocat*
children.translated_text: by the arm, drawing him aside to a private spot, said this to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>:

children.text: yat khalu bhadantānanda jānīyā asmin kiṭāgirāv aśvakapunarvasukau bhikṣū prativasataḥ kuladūṣakau pāpadharmasamudācārau tau mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ saṃcagghata
children.translated_text: 'Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, you should know that in this <s>Kiṭāgiri</s>, the monks <s>Aśvaka</s> and <s>Punarvasuka</s> reside — they are corrupters of families, of evil conduct. They have associated with women,

children.text: āyuṣmann ānanda pūrvavad yāvad yathā saṃghāvaśeṣe kuladūṣakaśikṣāpade aśvakapunarvasukayor bhikṣvoḥ pravāsanīyaṃ karma kuru
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, as before, up to: perform the act of banishment (<s>pravāsanīyaṃ karma</s>) against the monks <s>Aśvaka</s> and <s>Punarvasuka</s> according to the training rule on corrupters of families, with the <s>saṃgha</s> as remainder.
And this is how it should be done:
Standing within the boundary, a monk who is the proposer should be appointed.

children.text: paṃcabhir dharmaiḥ samanvāgataś codako bhikṣuḥ pūrvavad yāvat karma kurvanti
children.translated_text: A monk endowed with five qualities should be the proposer — as before, up to: they perform the formal act.
These monks <s>Aśvaka</s> and <s>Punarvasuka</s> are corrupters of families, of evil conduct.

children.text: ābhyāṃ kulāni dūṣitāni dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi praj
children.translated_text: The families corrupted by them are seen, heard,

children.text: pāpakāś cānayoḥ samudācārā dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi prajñāyante 'pi
children.translated_text: And their evil practices are seen, heard, and known.

children.text: sacet saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ kṣametānujānīyāt saṃgho yat saṃghaḥ aśvakapunarvasukayo
children.translated_text: If the time has come for the <s>saṃgha</s>, if the <s>saṃgha</s> approves and permits, the <s>saṃgha</s> should perform the act of banishment against the monks <s>Aśvaka</s> and <s>Punarvasuka</s>,

children.text: pāpadharmasamudācāriṇoḥ pravāsanīyaṃ karma kuryād ity eṣā jñaptiḥ // evaṃ ca karma kartavyaṃ pūrvavad yāvad evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācanā kartavyā Ś // //
children.translated_text: and of evil conduct.' This is the motion. And the formal act should be done thus — as before, up to: the second and third proclamations of the act should be made.

children.text: buddho bhagavāṃ śrāvastyāṃ viharati jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārame Ś tena khalu samayena śrāvastyām anyatama śreṣṭhī prativasati āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Buddha</s>, the Blessed One, was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>. Now at that time, a certain merchant was living at <s>Śrāvastī</s> — wealthy, of great riches, of great possessions.
He brought a wife from a family of equal status.

children.text: sa tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati
children.translated_text: He sported, enjoyed, and dallied with her.
enjoyed, and dallied, his wife became pregnant.

children.text: sā aṣṭānāṃ vā navānāṃ vā māsānām atyayād uttare nakṣatre prasūtā
children.translated_text: After the passage of eight or nine months, she gave birth under an auspicious <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation).

children.text: tasya jñātayaḥ saṃgamya samāgamya trīṇi saptakāny ekaviṃśatidivasāṃ jātasya jātimahaṃ kṛtvā nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpayanti
children.translated_text: His relatives, having come together and assembled, performed the birth-celebration for twenty-one days — three sets of seven — and established the name.

children.text: yasmād ayaṃ daraka uttare nakṣatre jāta
children.translated_text: 'Since this boy was born under the <s>Uttara</s> (northern) constellation,

children.text: tasmād bhavatu dārakasya uttara iti nāmeti Ś tasya uttara iti nāmadheyaṃ vyvasthāpitaṃ
children.translated_text: let the boy's name be <s>Uttara</s>.' Thus the name <s>Uttara</s> was established for him.

children.text: sa unnīyate vardhate kṣīreṇa dadhnā navanītena sarpiṣā sarpirmaṇḍenānyaiś cottaptottaptair upakaraṇaviśeṣair āśur vardhyate hradastham iva paṃkajaṃ
children.translated_text: He was brought up and grew, nourished with milk, curds, butter, ghee, and the cream of ghee, and with other most refined provisions — he grew quickly, like a lotus in a lake.

children.text: sa yadā mahān saṃvṛttas tadā lipyām upanyastaḥ saṃkhyāyāṃ gaṇanāyāṃ mudrāyāṃ uddhāre nyāse ni
children.translated_text: When he had grown up, he was instructed in writing, arithmetic, calculation, sealing, deposits, investments, and
casting out — he had gone to the far shore of writing.

children.text: ugdhāṭako vācakaḥ paṇḍitaḥ paṭupracāro 'ṣṭāsu parīkṣāsu kṛtāvī saṃvṛttaḥ
children.translated_text: He became a clever reader, a learned man, of sharp practice, accomplished in the eight examinations.

children.text: tadyathā ratnaparīkṣāyāṃ vastraparīkṣāyāṃ vastraparīkṣāyāṃ dāruparīkṣāyāṃ hastiparīkṣāyām aśvaparīkṣāyāṃ strīparīkṣāyāṃ puruṣaparīkṣāyāṃ ca kṛtāvī saṃvṛttaḥ
children.translated_text: Namely: accomplished in the examination of gems, the examination of cloth, the examination of cloth, the examination of wood, the examination of elephants, the examination of horses, the examination of women, and the examination of men.
<s>Uttara</s> became the master of the household.
He opened a shop — he bought and sold.
By buying and selling he maintained his livelihood.
On another occasion, he approached the presence of the Blessed One.

children.text: tasya bhagavaddarśanāt saddharmaśravaṇāc ca bhagavacchāsane prasādo jātaḥ
children.translated_text: From seeing the Blessed One and hearing the true <s>Dharma</s>, faith arose in him toward the Blessed One's teaching.
Having gained faith, he developed a desire for going forth (<s>pravrajyā</s>).

children.text: sa mātuḥ sakāśam upasaṃkramya kathayaty aṃbānujānīhi svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajāmīti
children.translated_text: He approached his mother and said: 'Mother, give me permission — I wish to go forth in the well-taught <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.'

children.text: sā kathayati tvaṃ mamaikaputro yāvad ahaṃ jīvāmi tāvan na pravrajitavyaṃ
children.translated_text: She said: 'You are my only son. As long as I am alive, you shall not go forth.'

children.text: mṛtāyāṃ mayi yatheṣṭaṃ kariṣyasīti Ś sa kathayaty aṃba samayenāhaṃ na pravrajāmi yadi tvaṃ divase divase saṃghoddiṣṭakān bhikṣūn bhājayasīti / sā kathayati putra evaṃ karomīti Ś sa cottaro yat kiṃcid upārjayati tat sarvaṃ mātre 'nuprayacchati Ś ambānena śramaṇabrāhmaṇān pratipādayeti Ś sāsya mātā matsarī kuṭukuṃcikā āgṛhītapariṣkārā kākāyāpi baliṃ na pradātuṃ vyavasyati prāg eva śramaṇabrāhmaṇān pratipādayiṣyati Ś ye tu śramaṇabrāhmaṇāḥ piṇḍārthinas taṃ gṛhaṃ praviśanti tān paribhāṣate tarjayati ca
children.translated_text: 'When I am dead, you may do as you wish.' He said: 'Mother, I will not go forth on this condition: that you feed the monks designated by the <s>saṃgha</s> every day.' She said: 'Son, I will do so.' And <s>Uttara</s> gave everything he earned to his mother [saying]: 'Mother, with this provide for <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.' But his mother was miserly, a miser, grasping in her possessions; she would not even offer a morsel to a crow — how much less would she provide for <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s>! And whatever <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s> entered that house seeking alms, she abused and threatened them:

children.text: pretopannā iva yūyaṃ nityaṃ paragṛhebhyo bhikṣām aṭateti / taṃ ca putraṃ vipralaṃbhayati adya mayā iyanto bhikṣavo bhojitā iyatān śramaṇabrāhmaṇā
children.translated_text: 'You are like the reborn dead, always begging from others' houses!' And she deceived her son [saying]: 'Today I have fed this many monks, I have given alms to this many <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.' Through that miserliness, practiced, developed, and cultivated, when she died, she was reborn among the <s>pretas</s> (hungry ghosts).

children.text: ṃ bhikṣā datteti Ś sā tena mātsaryeṇāsevitena bhāvitena bahulīkṛtena kālaṃ kṛtvā preteṣūpa

children.translated_text: <s>Uttara</s> too, from grief at his mother's death,

children.text: dānāni datvā puṇyāni kṛtvā svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajitaḥ
children.translated_text: having given gifts and performed meritorious deeds, went forth in the well-taught <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.
On another occasion, he was established at <s>Mrakṣaṣaṇḍā</s>.
Approaching him, the householder <s>Citra</s>, a resident of <s>Mrakṣaṣaṇḍā</s>,
had faith in the Blessed One's teaching.
He performed great services for the <s>Buddha</s>, the <s>Dharma</s>, and the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
<s>Mrakṣaṣaṇḍā</s> became a refuge for monks who came from various
Then on another occasion, the venerable
<s>Uttara</s> had some business arise in a certain market-town.

children.text: āyuṣmāṃś copaseno valgantīputro paṃcaśataparivāro janapadacārikāṃ caraṃ mrakṣaṣaṇḍām anuprāptaḥ
children.translated_text: And the venerable <s>Upasena Valgantīputra</s>, with a retinue of five hundred, wandering on a tour of the countryside, arrived at <s>Mrakṣaṣaṇḍā</s>.

children.text: aśrauṣīc citro gṛhapatir yathā upaseno valgantīputraḥ paṃcaśataparivāro janapadacārikāṃ carann ihānuprāpta iti
children.translated_text: The householder <s>Citra</s> heard that <s>Upasena Valgantīputra</s>, with a retinue of five hundred, wandering on a tour of the countryside, had arrived here.

children.text: śrutvā ca punar yenāyuṣmān upasenas tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
children.translated_text: Having heard, he approached the venerable <s>Upasena</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkramyāyuṣmata upasenasya pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte niṣaṇṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Having approached, he bowed with his head at the feet of the venerable <s>Upasena</s> and sat down to one side.

children.text: ekāntaniṣaṇṇaṃ citraṃ gṛhapatim āyuṣmān upaseno dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśayati samādāpayati samuttejayati saṃpraharṣayaty
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Upasena</s> instructed, inspired, encouraged, and delighted the householder <s>Citra</s>, seated to one side, with a talk on the <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: anekaparyāyeṇa dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśya samādāpya samuttejya saṃpraharṣya tūṣṇīm
children.translated_text: Having in many ways instructed, inspired, encouraged, and delighted [him] with a talk on the <s>Dharma</s>, he fell silent.

children.text: atha citro gṛhapatir utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā yenāyuṣmān upasenas tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamayyāyuṣmantam upasenam idam avocat*
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Citra</s>, rising from his seat, arranging his upper garment over one shoulder, extending his joined palms toward the venerable <s>Upasena</s>, said to the venerable <s>Upasena</s>:

children.text: adhivāsayatu me ārya upasenaś cāntargṛhe bhaktena sārdhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghenety
children.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>Upasena</s>, together with the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, accept a meal in my inner quarters.'

children.text: adhivāsayati āyuṣmān upasenaś citrasya gṛhapates tūṣṇīṃbhāvena
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Upasena</s> accepted the householder <s>Citra</s>'s [invitation] by silence.

children.text: atha citro gṛhapatir āyuṣmata upasenasya tūṣṇīṃbhāvenādhivāsanāṃ viditvā śucipraṇītaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ samudānīya kālyam evotthāyāsanakāni prajñapayaty
children.translated_text: Then the householder <s>Citra</s>, understanding the venerable <s>Upasena</s>'s acceptance through his silence, prepared pure and excellent hard and soft foods; and rising early in the morning, he had seats arranged.
And the venerable <s>Uttara</s> returned from that market-town.

children.text: yāvat paśyati na śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ nāpy āhāram upānvāhṛtaṃ
children.translated_text: He saw that neither seats were arranged nor food brought.

children.text: bhavanta kim alpotsukās tiṣṭhatha nāsanaprajñaptiḥ kriyate nāpy āhāra upānvāhriyate
children.translated_text: 'Sirs, do you stand idle with so little concern? Neither are seats being arranged nor food being brought!'
'Is the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> to have its meals cut off?'

children.text: te kathayanti citreṇa gṛhapatinā bhikṣusaṃgho 'ntargṛhe bhaktenopanimantritaḥ
children.translated_text: They said: 'The <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> has been invited to a meal in the inner quarters by the householder <s>Citra</s>.'

children.text: na tvām āgamya 'pi tu āryam upasenaṃ valgantīputraṃ
children.translated_text: 'Not on your account, but on account of the noble <s>Upasena Valgantīputra</s>.'
'He has arrived here, wandering on a tour of the countryside with a retinue of five hundred.'
Hearing this, he became resentful and said:

children.text: Ś katham asau māṃ pratyākhyāyāyuṣmantam upasenaṃ valgantīputraṃ bhikṣusaṃgham upanimantrayati Ś gacchāmi tāvat paśyāmīti / sa yena citro gṛhapatis tenopasaṃkrānto yāvat paśyati citraṃ gṛhapatim āsanaprajñaptiṃ kriyamāṇaṃ
children.translated_text: How can he reject me and invite the venerable <s>Upasena Valgantīputra</s> and the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>? I shall go and see!' He then approached the householder <s>Citra</s>; and he saw the householder <s>Citra</s> having the seats arranged.
'Noble one, the seating arrangement is excellent

children.text: śobhanaś cāhāra iti / citro gṛhapatis tilapūpalikāvaṇig āsīd
children.translated_text: and the food is excellent.' (The householder <s>Citra</s> was a dealer in sesame-cakes.)

children.text: uttaraḥ kathayati gṛhapate śobhanā āsanaprajñaptiḥ śobhanaś cāhāra
children.translated_text: <s>Uttara</s> said: 'Householder, the seating arrangement is excellent and the food is excellent,

children.text: tena hy upamāṃ tāvac chṛṇu : upamayā ca punar ihaike vijñapuruṣā bhāṣitasyārtham ājānanti Ś bhūtapūrvaṃ bhadantottara saṃbahulā jāṃbūdvīpakā vaṇijaḥ sāmudraṃ yānapātraṃ pratipādya kākaṃ kukkuṭīṃ cādāya mahāsamudram avatīrṇā dhanahārakāḥ
children.translated_text: 'But first hear a simile — for by a simile some wise persons understand the meaning of what is said: Once upon a time, venerable <s>Uttara</s>, many merchants of <s>Jambūdvīpa</s>, having outfitted a sea-going vessel and taking a crow and a hen, descended into the great ocean as wealth-seekers.'

children.text: yāvad asau kukkuṭī kukkuṭam alabhamānā kākena sārdhaṃ saṃvāsaṃ gatā : tayoḥ saṃvāsāc chāvako jātaḥ
children.translated_text: Meanwhile, that hen, not finding a rooster, entered into cohabitation with a crow; from their cohabitation, a chick was born.

children.text: sa kākakukkuṭīkaṃ vāśyate na kāko na kukkuṭaḥ
children.translated_text: It cries like a crow-hen hybrid — neither a crow nor a rooster.
